breaking_reply.definition: a legal defender reply after which the attacker has neither mate-in-one nor any checking continuation

checker_geometry.definition: each attacking piece whose own compiled Leap/Ray geometry reaches the defender Anchor square under child occupancy and ray blocking
required_contracts: every selected F86Q checking child has at least one exact checker
every breaking reply leaves defender not in check
CHECKER_CAPTURE removes at least one pre-reply checker

f86q_classifications.ESCAPABLE_CHECK: at least one legal opponent reply has neither attacker mate-in-one nor attacker checking continuation
f86q_classifications.FORCED_CHECK_CONTINUATION: not forced mate in two, and every legal opponent reply has at least one attacker checking action
f86q_classifications.FORCED_MATE_IN_TWO: every legal opponent reply has at least one attacker CHECKMATE action
f86q_classifications.MATE_IN_ONE: checking child is CHECKMATE with winner equal to the root actor

probe_accounting.new_successors: count opponent replies and attacker continuations, as in F86Q
probe_accounting.replay: replay frozen F86O trajectories and analyze only frozen F86Q selected root/checking-action pairs
